why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Amed Rosario is slot #5 (4.721 expected team runs/game).
Slots #5, #8, #7, #6, #9, #4, #3 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #3 ranks 7 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.005 R/G.
Slot #5 yields 4.27 expected PA/game vs 4.48 at primary slot #3. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
